steps.title: See Cru think and speak in the conversation
steps.body: While Cru works on an answer, typing dots show where its reply will appear. Beside each reply, a speaking head plays it aloud when you tap it, and moves while that reply is being said. Tap it again to stop.

keys.text: hear a reply, or stop it

steps.title: Cru can fill the whole screen with its own UI
steps.body: When something needs the room, a dashboard, a board or a game, Cru can take over the whole of its screen while the bar to type or speak stays. A Normal view button on the top bar takes you back at any time, with what Cru showed kept as its panel.

keys.text: back to the usual Cru screen
